mapper.sql: id, order_id, applicant_worker_id, original_assignee_id, reason_type, reason_description, approval_status, review_admin_id, review_remark, review_time, execute_status, new_assignee_id, execute_time, failure_reason, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM repair_transfer_request WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM repair_transfer_request WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND approval_status=0 AND deleted=0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE repair_transfer_request SET approval_status=#{approvalStatus},review_admin_id=#{adminId},review_remark=#{remark},review_time=#{now},execute_status=CASE WHEN #{approvalStatus}=1 THEN 1 ELSE execute_status END WHERE id=#{id} AND approval_status=0 AND deleted=0

UPDATE repair_transfer_request SET execute_status=#{executeStatus},new_assignee_id=#{newAssigneeId},failure_reason=#{failureReason},execute_time=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND approval_status=1 AND execute_status=1 AND deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM repair_transfer_request tr JOIN repair_order ro ON ro.id=tr.order_id WHERE tr.deleted=0 AND tr.applicant_worker_id=#{workerId}AND ro.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.orderNo},'%')AND tr.applicant_worker_id=#{query.applicantWorkerId}AND tr.approval_status=#{query.approvalStatus}AND tr.create_time>=#{query.createStartTime}AND tr.create_time<=#{query.createEndTime} ORDER BY tr.create_time DESC,tr.id DESC
SELECT FROM repair_transfer_request tr JOIN repair_order ro ON ro.id=tr.order_id WHERE tr.id=#{id} AND tr.deleted=0
